Each identified victim’s family will get Tk3.35 lakh from the Wage Earners’ Welfare Board.
Fingerprint tests identified nine victims; DNA testing is underway for the remaining seven.

tbsnews.net/bangladesh/zero-tolerance-gr.headline: Bangladesh Announces Zero‑Tolerance Policy to Combat Police Corruption, Dismissals and Criminal Prosecutions

New online services and a complaint cell aim to eliminate direct cash payments and protect whistle‑blowers.
Body‑worn cameras and ethical training are introduced to boost accountability.

Bangladesh emphasized peaceful, safe use of nuclear tech to support sustainable development
US expressed interest and listed modern nuclear technology as a priority for collaboration

deposit_memos_haircut.headline: Depositors Protest Four Chattogram Banks Over Proposed Deposit Haircut

Bank officials met with depositors to discuss returning funds and recent Bangladesh Bank directives.

jackson_hole_keynote.headline: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh to Speak at Jackson Hole Amid Market Uncertainty

highlights: Warsh has created five task forces to reassess inflation views, balance‑sheet policy, data reliance, technology and
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced a plan to double weekly off‑the‑run debt buybacks starting Sept. 9.
